{{Otheruses|Floater}}
A '''floater plat''' was a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] platform used by security officials. The [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] track on [[Stassia]] employed floater plats to allow their security personnel to move around the stadium.
